note: Written by hand from direct probcli runs. `z-spec test` stops probcli at 600 s and this model needs about 900 s and -p MAX_INITIALISATIONS 400 (108 initial states), so its own report records states_analysed 0. Mode 1 runs: the spec with `mode = 1`, -nodead.
